selection_process: Selection of Para Legal Volunteers is made through an interview conducted by DLSA Sheikhpura's selection committee. The selection committee's decision is final and binding. Since reservation does not apply to this voluntary role
selection will be done area/region-wise to ensure representation from village-level groups across the district. Candidates should check the Civil Court
Sheikhpura official website (sheikhpura.dcourts.gov.in) for the interview date.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the Civil Court, Sheikhpura official website, or collect it from the DLSA/Sadar office.
Attach self-attested photocopies of certificates for educational and other qualifications.
Attach a self-addressed envelope bearing a ₹55 postage stamp with the application.
Write your contact (mobile) number on the application form.
Send the completed application by registered post, or deliver it by hand, to: Secretary, District Legal Service Authority, Vyavhar Nyayalaya, Sheikhpura, PIN 811105.
Ensure the application reaches this address between 12 August 2026 and 11 September 2026, 5:00 PM. Applications received after this date will not be considered.
There is no online application process for this recruitment; applications must be submitted only by post or in person at the address above.
important_instructions: Previously selected and currently working Para Legal Volunteers under DLSA Sheikhpura must submit a fresh application; they may be given preference in the selection process. The application must be filled completely, with self-attested photocopies of all qualification certificates attached. A self-addressed envelope with a ₹55 postage stamp must be enclosed with the application. The applicant's mobile number must be written on the application. Applicants must declare in the application whether they are a party (applicant or opposite party) to any pending court case, and provide details of the court, relevant sections, and bail status if applicable, along with whether they have been convicted by any court or are absconding in any case. Applicants must submit a declaration confirming they have no pending criminal case against them, have not been convicted or declared bankrupt by any competent court, and wish to perform legal service voluntarily without seeking any personal benefit. Information regarding the interview and final selection can be downloaded from the "Recruitments" link on sheikhpura.dcourts.gov.in. This notice will be displayed on the notice boards of the Vyavhar Nyayalaya, the DLSA office, all Legal Aid Centres, and the District Information & Public Relations Office; a copy is also being sent to the District Bar Association for display on its notice board.

content_sections.text: Applications received after 11 September 2026, 5:00 PM will not be considered under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Sheikhpura Para Legal Volunteer Posts 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 100 Para Legal Volunteer positions are available. Since PLVs are expected to work in village-level groups, selection will be done area/region-wise across all parts of Sheikhpura district, rather than through a single district-wide merit list. The final decision on the number and distribution of posts rests with DLSA Sheikhpura. Previously selected and currently serving Para Legal Volunteers under DLSA Sheikhpura must also submit a fresh application, and may be given preference in selection. Spreading legal awareness in their local area Acting as a bridge between people needing legal aid and DLSA Providing legal-aid-related work support at the Authority's office and at Legal Aid Centres Any other work assigned by the DLSA office

content_sections.heading: DLSA Sheikhpura PLV Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Must be a permanent resident of Sheikhpura district, Bihar Must be physically and mentally fit Must be of good character and interested in social service Must not be an accused or convicted person in any criminal case Must not be a member of any political party The notice specifically invites applications from persons (women, men, or others) who wish to work for the upliftment of weaker and deprived sections of society without seeking any financial benefit, including: teachers (serving or retired), retired government employees, senior citizens, Anganwadi workers, doctors, students (including law students not yet enrolled as an advocate), and members of non-governmental organisations, clubs, self-help groups, Maitri Samooh, Jeevika group members, or other individuals interested in voluntary service whom DLSA considers suitable to be identified as a Para Legal Volunteer. Matric (10th) pass or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Sheikhpura PLV Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum age: 18 years. No maximum age limit is specified in this notice.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Sheikhpura PLV Recruitment 2026 Honorarium
content_sections.text: Selected Para Legal Volunteers will receive a honorarium of ₹750 (seven hundred fifty rupees) per day . This amount is payable only for the specific days on which the DLSA assigns the volunteer a particular task - it is not a fixed monthly salary.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Sheikhpura PLV Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection of Para Legal Volunteers is made through an interview conducted by DLSA Sheikhpura's selection committee. The selection committee's decision is final and binding. Since reservation does not apply to this voluntary role, selection is not category-based; however, selection will be done area/region-wise to ensure representation from village-level groups across the district. Candidates should check the Civil Court, Sheikhpura official website (sheikhpura.dcourts.gov.in) for the interview date.
